title: OTP Field
summary: A one-time code entered in single-character cells over one value.

examples.label: Six-digit code (default)
examples.subject: component:otp-field
examples.markup: <ui-field label="Verification code" description="Sent to your phone."><ui-otp-field name="code" length="6" required></ui-otp-field></ui-field>
examples.note: React: <Field label="Verification code">{(ids) => <OTPField {...ids} name="code" length={6} required />}</Field>.

examples.label: 3 + 3 with a separator
examples.subject: component:otp-field
examples.note: React: OTPField.Root length={6} › three OTPField.Input, OTPField.Separator, three OTPField.Input.

examples.label: Alphanumeric, masked, auto-submit
examples.subject: component:otp-field
examples.markup: <ui-otp-field name="key" label="Recovery key" length="4" validation-type="alphanumeric" mask auto-submit></ui-otp-field>
